{{recipe}}

A Monte Cristo sandwich is a sort of savory French toast sandwich. This recipe combines the traditional sandwich with the hamburger.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] 80/20 ground [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|chuck]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 4 hamburger buns, halved
* Few shots of hot sauce
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 4 slices [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
* Nonstick [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 200°F.
#Combine the egg, hot sauce, and cream in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]]. Dip cut sides of buns into egg mixture. Move to a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]] and let sit 10 minutes.
#Heat a medium [[Cookbook:Non-stick|nonstick]] [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium heat. Grease with cooking spray.
#Add buns, one at a time, and cook until browned on cut side. Move to a clean plate and repeat until all buns have been cooked. Keep warm in the oven.
#Form beef into 4 equal patties. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] both sides with olive oil and sprinkle both sides liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Heat about 28 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Once hot, disperse evenly around the bottom of a [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] and reapply grate. Add patties and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 145°F for medium rare, 160°F for medium, and 170°F for toast.
#Remove to a plate, top with cheese, and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 3 minutes.
#Place a patty on the bottom half of each bun. Top with upper half and serve warm.

steps.text: Combine the egg, hot sauce, and cream in a pie plate. Dip cut sides of buns into egg mixture. Move to a cooling rack and let sit 10 minutes.
Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Grease with cooking spray.
Add buns, one at a time, and cook until browned on cut side. Move to a clean plate and repeat until all buns have been cooked. Keep warm in the oven.
Form beef into 4 equal patties. Brush both sides with olive oil and sprinkle both sides liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

Heat about 28 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Once hot, disperse evenly around the bottom of a grill and reapply grate. Add patties and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 145°F for medium rare, 160°F for medium, and 170°F for toast.
Remove to a plate, top with cheese, and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest 3 minutes.
Place a patty on the bottom half of each bun. Top with upper half and serve warm.
